title: Unwinding Toxic Flow with Partial Information
abstract: arXiv:2407.04510v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider a central trading desk which aggregates the inflow of clients' orders with unobserved toxicity, i.e. persistent adverse directionality. The desk chooses either to internalise the inflow or externalise it to the market in a cost-effective manner. In this model, externalising the order flow creates both price impact costs and an additional market feedback reaction for the inflow of trades. The desk's objective is to maximise the daily trading P&L subject to end-of-day inventory penalisation. We formulate this setting as a partially observable stochastic control problem and solve it in two steps. First, we derive the filtered dynamics of the inventory and toxicity, projected to the observed filtration, which turns the stochastic control problem into a fully observed problem. translated_title: 基于部分信息的有毒订单流平仓
translated_abstract: 我们考虑一个中央交易台，它汇总流入的客户订单，这些订单具有不可观测的毒性，即持续的不利方向性。交易台选择以成本效益的方式将流入订单内部化，或将其外部化到市场。在该模型中，将订单流外部化既会产生价格冲击成本，也会对交易流入产生额外的市场反馈反应。交易台的目标是在日终库存惩罚的约束下最大化每日交易损益。我们将此设定表述为部分可观测的随机控制问题，并分两步进行求解。首先，我们推导出投影到可观测信息流上的库存和毒性的滤波动力学，从而将随机控制问题转化为完全可观测的问题。然后，我们使用变分方法推导出唯一的最优交易策略。我们通过多种情景展示了我们的结果，其中……
tldr: 本文将交易台在客户订单毒性不可观测条件下选择内部化或外部化订单流的问题建模为部分可观测随机控制问题，通过滤波投影将其转化为完全可观测问题，并利用变分方法求解出唯一的最优交易策略。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates a trading desk's problem of internalizing or externalizing client order flow with unobserved toxicity as a partially observable stochastic control problem, converts it to a fully observed one via filtered dynamics, and derives the unique optimal trading strategy using a variational approach.
